tile_road_distance — DRIVE inf op

• Data kinds: any × any × table → any

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.tile_road_distance(i: 'int', j: 'int', x, y, tp: 'dict') -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import driveinf; driveinf.tile_road_distance(i: 'int', j: 'int', x, y, tp: 'dict') -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("tile_road_distance"))

Usage

Distance from point (x, y) in tile (i, j) (in-tile coordinates) to the nearest road centerline. ★Also looks at the roads of the 8 neighboring tiles (shifting them into in-tile coordinates) — so that the tiles on both sides of a seam give the same distance near it.
